label: copy phase, late positions, input token in {2,u,p,1,n} (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original or delimiter steps), almost entirely at recall_idx >= 3, when the fed-back input token is one of 2, u, p, 1, n (2 carries ~39% of mass, u 23%, p 20%, 1 11%, n 7%). Rate rises with L and with t (highest at recall_idx 8 / L=9). The predicate covers ~99.7% of activation mass on dev, but only ~6% of matching steps actually fire: which ones do depends on combinations of the preceding token (prev_tok j, c, i, a, v enrich ~3-4x) and the current output token (p, j, k, 2, u, g, b enrich), and adding these conjunctions trades recall for precision without exceeding F1 ~0.33. Magnitudes are tiny (max 0.008) and I did not find a clean modulator of magnitude beyond the token identities. Does not fire on other input tokens (q, g, b, o, 0, h, a essentially never).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=1 (+6.51), phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+5.94), phase=2 & in_tok=n (+5.26), phase=2 & in_tok=u (+5.23), phase=2 & in_tok=p (+5.19), phase=2 & out_tok=p (+2.96). Lower it: correct=1 (-4.24), prev2_tok=<DEL> (-2.82), recall_idx=2 (-2.82), out_tok=x (-2.71).
